description: Frontend wiring for evolution branches: (1) render a per-variant SVG sprite selected by (tier, form); (2) show a StatsPanel hint about what the current care tendency is steering the next evolution toward, derived from the SAME shared branch function so the hint cannot contradict the real outcome; (3) add JA/EN i18n keys for variant labels + the hint; (4) ensure the load path normalizes `form` for legacy saves and all MonsterSprite call sites pass the form. Depends on FEAT-002 (MonsterForm, formOf, predictedNextForm) and keeps JA strings byte-identical for existing keys. Frontend-only, requires a frontend redeploy.
steps: Sprites: in packages/frontend/src/assets/monsters/, make MonsterSprite select by (tier, form). Lightweight approach (no heavy assets, no new deps): parameterize the existing Baby/Rookie/Champion/Ultimate SVG components with a per-form accent — e.g. extend MonsterSpriteProps with an optional `form?: MonsterForm` and derive a per-variant accent color / small accessory (attack = fiery red/orange accent + sharper horn; defense = sturdy green/blue accent + shield-like belly; mischief = purple accent + crooked grin), while 'base' keeps the current look byte-identical. Keep each variant visually distinct but reuse the existing SVG skeleton. Baby tier always renders the base look (no variant). Update MonsterSprite.tsx MonsterSpriteSelectProps to accept `form` and pass it through to the stage component; default form 'base' preserves today's rendering.
Update MonsterSprite.tsx so the switch picks the stage component and passes the form; keep the default fallback (unknown stage -> Baby) and ensure an undefined form behaves as 'base'.

Update MonsterSprite call sites to pass the form: packages/frontend/src/App.tsx (the main sprite, size 200) uses formOf(game.monster); packages/frontend/src/components/BattlePanel.tsx renders the PLAYER sprite with the player's form (pass a playerForm prop derived from the monster) and the ENEMY sprite with 'base' (generated enemies have no form). Thread a form value from the monster into these components as needed (App already has game.monster; BattlePanel takes playerStageId today, add an optional playerForm prop defaulting to 'base').

Load-path normalization: in packages/frontend/src/state/useMonster.ts `advance()`, chain `normalizeForm(...)` alongside the existing normalizeBattleRecord(normalizeAffection(applyTimePassage(...))) so live state always has a concrete form for the UI. Import normalizeForm from @ddm/shared.

StatsPanel hint: in packages/frontend/src/components/StatsPanel.tsx, inside the existing `.evolution-progress` block and only when NOT final stage, add a hint line showing the predicted next form from the shared predictedNextForm(monster, now) (same `now` already computed). Render a localized sentence like JA '今の育て方だと{form}型に進化しそう' / EN 'Current care is steering toward a {form}-type evolution', using i18n variant labels. If predictedNextForm is null (final stage or next tier is baby) render nothing. Keep it accessible (plain text paragraph, no color-only meaning).

i18n: in packages/frontend/src/i18n.ts add NEW keys in BOTH the ja block (near the existing stats.* keys ~line 72) and the en block (~line 202). Suggested keys: 'form.attack' (ja '攻撃', en 'Attack'), 'form.defense' (ja '防御', en 'Defense'), 'form.mischief' (ja 'やんちゃ', en 'Mischief'); and a hint template 'stats.evolveHint' (ja '今の育て方だと{form}型に進化しそう', en 'Current care is steering toward a {form}-type evolution'). Do NOT modify any existing key's value (JA byte-identical). Keep ja and en in exact key parity. If a ui-helpers formatter is the project convention for templated strings (see how stats.finalStage uses .replace('{stage}', ...)), follow the same .replace('{form}', label) approach in StatsPanel.

Optional but preferred: expose a small ui-helpers.ts function `formLabel(form, lang)` (mirroring stageLabel) that maps a MonsterForm to the localized label, and reuse it in StatsPanel. Add a focused test for formLabel + the hint string composition in packages/frontend/src/game-ui.test.ts (node:test), e.g. given a monster with a known care profile, the hint text matches the expected JA and EN strings and is derived from predictedNextForm (so it agrees with chooseEvolutionForm). Keep the existing 90 frontend tests passing and add to the total.

If the EvolutionBanner (packages/frontend/src/components/EvolutionBanner.tsx) should mention the new form, that is optional; if changed, keep JA existing keys byte-identical and add any new string in both languages. Do not break the existing justEvolvedTo flow in useMonster.ts.
Run `npm run build` (Vite + tsc) and `npm test`; confirm the frontend suite passes with a higher total than the FEAT-001 baseline and no TS errors.
acceptance_criteria: MonsterSprite renders a visually distinct sprite per (tier, form) for attack/defense/mischief while 'base'/undefined keeps today's rendering byte-identical; baby tier always renders base.
All MonsterSprite call sites (App.tsx main sprite, BattlePanel player sprite) pass the monster's form; the generated enemy renders as base.

StatsPanel shows a localized next-evolution hint derived from the SAME shared predictedNextForm/chooseEvolutionForm function (cannot contradict the real outcome), hidden at the final stage; JA and EN both present.
New i18n keys exist in both ja and en with exact parity; no existing key value changed (JA byte-identical).
Load path normalizes form via normalizeForm so legacy saves render as base; a new frontend test covers the hint/label and passes.
`npm run build` and `npm test` pass with the frontend total above the FEAT-001 baseline; no new runtime dependency.
findings:
COMPLETED. Frontend-only; requires a FRONTEND REDEPLOY (Vite build output not committed). Files changed (all packages/frontend/src): - assets/monsters/formAccent.tsx (NEW): FormAccent({form, stage}) renders a lightweight per-variant SVG accent overlay (attack=fiery red/orange flame mark; defense=green/blue shield emblem over belly; mischief=purple crooked grin + spark). Returns null for form 'base' or undefined, so base rendering stays BYTE-IDENTICAL. Decorative (aria-hidden); no new deps/assets. Coordinates in the shared 0 0 200 200 viewBox; head/belly anchors shift per stage. - assets/monsters/Baby.tsx: MonsterSpriteProps extended with optional form?: MonsterForm (imported from @ddm/shared). Baby ignores form (always base). - assets/monsters/Rookie.tsx, Champion.tsx, Ultimate.tsx: accept form, render as the LAST child inside the SVG (purely additive -> base/undefined unchanged). - assets/monsters/MonsterSprite.tsx: MonsterSpriteSelectProps already extends MonsterSpriteProps (so gains form); switch passes form to Rookie/Champion/Ultimate; baby + default fallback render base (no form). Undefined form behaves as base. - App.tsx: import formOf; main sprite now ; BattlePanel gets playerForm={formOf(game.monster)}. - components/BattlePanel.tsx: new optional prop playerForm?: MonsterForm (default 'base'); the two PLAYER sprites (preview size 88, combatant size 110) pass form={playerForm}; the ENEMY sprite (size 96) renders base (no form prop) since generated enemies have no form. - components/StatsPanel.tsx: import predictedNextForm (@ddm/shared) + formLabel (ui-helpers). Inside .evolution-progress non-final branch, computes predicted = prog.isFinalStage ? null : predictedNextForm(monster, now) using the SAME now; evolveHint = t('stats.evolveHint').replace('{form}', formLabel(predicted, lang)). Renders

only when the hint is non-empty. Accessible plain text (full sentence), not color-only. - ui-helpers.ts: import MonsterForm type; added formLabel(form, lang) mirroring stageLabel -> t(lang, `form.${form}`) for the three variants, '' for 'base'. StatsPanel reuses it. (predictedNextForm/chooseEvolutionForm never return 'base', but formLabel('base') returns '' and the StatsPanel guard skips the hint, so a 'base' prediction can never leak an empty hint.) - state/useMonster.ts: import normalizeForm; advance() now returns normalizeForm(normalizeBattleRecord(normalizeAffection(applyTimePassage(monster, now)))) so legacy (pre-#38) saves always have a concrete form ('base') for the sprite + hint. - i18n.ts: NEW keys in BOTH ja (after stats.elapsed ~line 76) and en (mirrored): 'stats.evolveHint' (ja '今の育て方だと{form}型に進化しそう' / en 'Current care is steering toward a {form}-type evolution'), 'form.attack' (ja 攻撃 / en Attack), 'form.defense' (ja 防御 / en Defense), 'form.mischief' (ja やんちゃ / en Mischief). No existing key value changed (JA byte-identical); ja/en key parity enforced by the existing 'MESSAGES.ja and MESSAGES.en have identical key sets' test. - styles.css: added .evolution-hint (accent color, plain text; no animation so prefers-reduced-motion unaffected). - game-ui.test.ts: +9 tests (formLabel ja/en for each variant, sourced-from-i18n, base->''; composeEvolveHint for attack/defense/mischief babies derived from predictedNextForm matching chooseEvolutionForm, exact JA+EN hint strings; hint hidden at final stage; evolveHint template token check). Verification: `npm run build` (tsc + vite, all 4 workspaces) PASS. `npm test -w @ddm/frontend` 99 pass / 0 fail (was 90 baseline, +9). Root `npm test` 117 pass / 0 fail. No new runtime dependency.
